newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-BEST PERFORMANCE BY MIDWEEK SIDE, SAYS COTTON.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BEST PERFORMANCE BY MIDWEEK SIDE, SAYS COTTON.

text.p: Tour manager Fran Cotton praised the British Lions for giving "the finest performance by a midweek team I've ever seen" after their 52-30 victory over Free State on Tuesday.
But Cotton would not be drawn on possible team changes for the second test against South Africa on Saturday.
Newcastle wing John Bentley pressed his claims for a place with a hat-trick of tries against Free State but said he was taking nothing for granted.
"I did okay...There'll be disappointments among the 35 of us this weekend, of course, and if I'm one of them I'll handle it in my own way," he said.
"But then I'll positively get behind the lads and encourage them to win the series."
One player who will not be available for selection is Will Greenwood.
His tour is over after he sustained concussion when he fell victim to a heavy tackle in first half injury time.
The Leicester centre will spend the night in hospital in Bloemfontein before flying home at the weekend.
The Lions will select their side for the second test on Wednesday but will not be announcing details until Thursday.
